newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel slips on year-end related sales.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel slips on year-end related sales.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp shares slipped lower in Monday morning trade due to selling ahead of book-closing at the end of March, brokers said.
At 0156 GMT, the steelmaker's shares were down six yen at 287 yen. It was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with volume of 3.459 million shares.

"Institutional investors' selling is not abating," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "Most market participants think that selling ahead of the end of the fiscal year on March 31 will continue and there is no bottom for the share prices in sight."
Other brokers said investors feel that the growth potential for steelmakers is limited and are opting to sell off the shares they have.
